label: Personality system (global)
description: Superordinate node: the person's organized pattern of traits, adaptations, and narrative; interfaces with all other UPG strata

label: Dispositional traits
description: Layer 1: broad, decontextualized, relatively stable dispositions; Big Five as consensus structure

label: Characteristic adaptations
description: Layer 2: contextualized goals, values, self-schemas, and if-then signatures

label: Narrative identity
description: Layer 3: internalized, evolving life story conferring unity and purpose

label: Momentary states
description: Distribution of momentary thoughts, feelings, and behaviors; traits as density distributions of states

label: Situations / contexts
description: Everyday contexts and activities; interface node to the Systems stratum (Batch H)

label: Consequential outcomes
description: Health, work, relationship, and societal outcomes predicted by personality
primary_source: Ozer & Benet-Martínez (2006)*; Roberts et al. (2007)*; Hampson (2012)

label: Temperament substrate
description: Biologically-based early-appearing dispositions; interface node to the Temperament stratum (Batch E)

label: Situation selection
description: Instrumental process: trait-consistent choice of environments and activities

label: Evocation
description: Instrumental process: traits elicit characteristic responses from others

label: Reactive processes
description: Moderating process: trait-dependent construal of and reactivity to the same situation

label: Instrumental mediation
description: Mediating process: traits produce outcomes through intervening behaviors (e.g., health behaviors)

label: Cybernetic goal loop
description: Goal-action-feedback control cycle organizing trait function

label: Neuroticism
description: Negative emotionality: threat sensitivity and distress proneness

label: Extraversion
description: Positive emotionality: sociability, assertiveness, reward sensitivity

label: Goals and motives
description: Personal strivings, life tasks, motive dispositions

label: Life-story themes
description: Agency and communion themes across the internalized story

label: Redemption/contamination sequences
description: Valenced narrative arcs linked to generativity and wellbeing
